summary: The scalar b(det(1, z)) has absolute value 1, and translation by a central scalar preserves the pairing.

steps.claim: Moving the factor b(det(1, z)) across the inner product conjugates it; being a value of a unitary character it has absolute value 1, so its conjugate is b(det(1, z))⁻¹ = b(det(1, z⁻¹)). The translation by the central scalar z is unitary for the pairing of forms (smoothPairing_formTranslation applied to centralRep(z⁻¹)x and y): ⟨x, R(z)y⟩ = ⟨R(z)R(z⁻¹)x, R(z)y⟩ = ⟨R(z⁻¹)x, y⟩.
steps.lean:
inner ℂ (Y.twistedCentralOp z⁻¹ x) y := by with_unfolding_all simpa [twistedCentralOp,
  ← Circle.coe_inv_eq_conj, ← MonoidHom.inr_apply, field] using!
  (congr(_ * $(smoothPairing_formTranslation _ _ (Y.centralRep z⁻¹ x).toSmoothForm
  y.toSmoothForm)) : (Y.centralRep z (Y.centralRep z⁻¹ x)).innerAt 1 (Y.centralRep z y) = _)
